issues.description: Framebuffer base identifier mismatch: the problem statement and template refer to the framebuffer base as 'display_start', but the solution's .bss declares the buffer as 'screen_buffer' while the solution code still uses the identifier 'display_start'. Specifically, template defines 'display_start' (template/pixel.asm) and the problem text names 'display_start' (problem_statement.md), whereas solution/pixel.asm declares 'screen_buffer' at its .bss and contains references to 'display_start' (e.g. 'add eax, display_start' and 'mov esi, display_start'). This will cause an assembly/link error (undefined symbol) and confuses students who expect the same identifier across artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the framebuffer symbol consistent across all artifacts. Either rename the solution's declaration 'screen_buffer' to 'display_start' in solution/pixel.asm .bss, or update all references in the solution code to use 'screen_buffer' and update the problem statement and template to that name. Preferred minimal fix: change line declaring 'screen_buffer RESB 8294400' to 'display_start RESB 8294400' in solution/pixel.asm so the existing references to 'display_start' resolve and match the template/problem text.
